Patna men divangat purv rajyasbha sansad do. ravindr kishor sinha ke brahmabhoj par shraddhanjli sabha huee. ismen mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri, jan suraj ke sansthapak prashant kishor aur RJD neta rohini aachary pahunche. tinon ki sath vali tasvir vayral ho gaee.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
